scope: Exercise mouse hover over each GTK2 scrollbar stepper in private Xvfb and compare its 15x15 cell to generated PRELIGHT/focused assets.

runtime.palette: Current generated KDE roles; no fixed RGB added
runtime.input: XWarpPointer to each stepper center; one GDK enter and motion event per target; button1 mask clear; coordinates confirmed by GDK widget/window pointer query

interpretation: All four hover captures render exactly as the generated PRELIGHT/focused assets. In this recipe left/right/up PRELIGHT artwork is pixel-identical to normal; only the lower arrow changes, by 11 pixels. The parent GtkScrollbar still reports GTK_STATE_NORMAL (0); the evidence for the stepper route is the delivered enter/motion event at the cell and the cell pixel match.
historical_limit: The rules contract explicitly leaves native SR10.4 hover unverified. No current VM hover capture was made; its screenshot has no pointer visible over a target. The 11-pixel lower-only hover difference is a candidate asymmetry, not yet a demonstrated mismatch to VUE.
next: Keep this as an open GTK2/VUE comparison. Do not normalize the asymmetric hover state without native evidence.
